data.one_liner: Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM/SPP serial communication plugin for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows discovering, pairing, connecting to, and exchanging data with Bluetooth Classic devices like Arduino, ESP32, and thermal printers. Exposes connections as Dart streams and sinks across Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, and iOS.
use_when: You need to communicate with Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM/SPP) peripherals like ESP32, HC-05, or thermal printers.
You want stream-based reading and writing of bytes or line-by-line data from classic Bluetooth devices.
You need a cross-platform solution supporting Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, and iOS (MFi).
avoid_when: You are working with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices instead of Bluetooth Classic.
You need to run your app in web browsers where Bluetooth Classic is unavailable.
strengths: Unified Dart API wrapping native platform stacks for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, and iOS.
Streamed I/O with built-in line/frame reader and request/response support.
Supports both client and server roles, plus discovery, pairing, and adapter state streams.
weaknesses: iOS support is strictly limited to MFi-certified accessories.
Platform limits prevent connection RSSI on Android, iOS, and Windows.
data.setup_notes: Android permissions are included automatically by the plugin. iOS requires configuring MFi protocols in Info.plist when working with accessories.
